title: Casual Relief Teacher (CRT) - Primary
description:
Bluegum Education Staffing places casual relief teachers (CRTs) in government, Catholic and independent primary schools across Melbourne's northern suburbs.

As a CRT with us you choose the days you work, receive bookings through our app and build relationships with schools close to home. Many of our teachers use CRT work to find longer contracts.

You will need current VIT registration, a primary teaching qualification and a reliable car. We pay weekly and provide free professional learning on classroom management for relief teaching.

title: Registered Nurse - Paediatrics
description:
Northside Childrens Health is seeking Registered Nurses for our paediatric medical ward. You must hold current AHPRA registration as a Registered Nurse and have at least 12 months of acute paediatric experience. Rotating rosters including night shift. Salary packaging available.

You will care for infants and children with complex medical needs, administer medications, and work closely with families and the wider multidisciplinary team. A graduate certificate in paediatric nursing is highly regarded.

title: Year 1 Educator - Ongoing, 1.0 FTE
description:
Footscray Park Primary is looking for a Year 1 educator to join our junior team from the start of next year.

What you will do:
- Plan and teach a Year 1 class of around 22 students
- Deliver our daily phonics block using decodable readers
- Assess reading progress each term and adjust small-group instruction
- Work with families, our learning support team and the school's wellbeing staff

What we need:
- VIT registration (full or provisional)
- A primary teaching qualification
- Experience or strong interest in explicit early literacy teaching

We offer a supportive team, protected planning time and a mentoring program for early-career teachers. Ongoing, full-time, Classroom Teacher Range 1-2 depending on experience.

title: Principal - Primary School
description:
Wyndham Vale North Primary School (enrolment 720) is seeking a principal to lead the school from Term 1.

The principal is responsible for the educational leadership, strategic direction, staff management and financial management of the school.

Selection criteria include demonstrated success in senior school leadership (assistant principal or principal level), experience leading whole-school improvement, managing budgets and leading a staff of more than 60. Current VIT registration required.

title: Year 3 Class Teacher
description:
Raffles Park International School follows an English national curriculum in Singapore. We are seeking a Year 3 class teacher from August.

The role is on-site in Singapore. Requirements: qualified primary teacher with at least two years of experience; experience teaching early literacy. Relocation allowance, housing allowance and annual flights home provided.

title: Secondary Science Teacher - VCE Physics
description:
Bayside Secondary College is seeking a science teacher to teach VCE Physics Units 1-4 and Years 7-10 Science.

Essential: VIT registration with a Physics teaching method (senior secondary); a degree with a major in physics or a closely related discipline; knowledge of the VCE Physics study design.

Ongoing, full time.

title: Primary Teacher Recruitment Consultant (Sales)
description:
ClassReady Recruitment places primary and secondary teachers in schools across Victoria. We are hiring a recruitment consultant to win new school clients and place teachers.

This is a target-driven sales role: business development calls, client meetings, candidate sourcing and hitting monthly placement targets. Ex-teachers welcome, but sales or recruitment experience is preferred. Uncapped commission.

title: Year 2 Primary Teacher
description:
Box Hill North Primary School is seeking a Year 2 primary teacher for an ongoing position from Term 1.

You will join a team of four Year 2 teachers, teach a class of 24 and deliver our daily phonics and decodable reading block.

Requirements:

  • VIT registration
  • A primary teaching qualification
  • Experience with explicit phonics instruction

title: Payroll Officer
description:
We provide shared payroll and finance services to independent schools across Victoria. We are seeking a Payroll Officer to process fortnightly payroll for around 1,800 school staff.

You will need at least two years of end-to-end payroll experience, strong knowledge of awards and enterprise agreements, and experience with a cloud payroll system. A Certificate IV in Payroll is desirable.

Hybrid working available (3 days in the office).

title: Learning Specialist - Literacy (Primary)
description:
Pascoe Vale Lakes Primary School is seeking a Learning Specialist to strengthen literacy teaching across the school.

The Learning Specialist role combines a reduced classroom load (0.6) with coaching colleagues, modelling lessons and leading the literacy professional learning team.

Selection criteria:
- Current VIT registration
- At least five years of successful primary teaching experience
- Expert knowledge of evidence-based literacy instruction, including systematic synthetic phonics
- Demonstrated ability to coach and lead adult learners
- Strong data literacy

Learning Specialist range, ongoing.

title: Classroom Teacher - Year 2 (Ongoing)
description:
Merri Creek Primary School sits beside the creek trail in Preston and has been part of its community for more than 120 years. We are a school of around 480 students from over 30 cultural backgrounds, and we are proud of the warm, inclusive culture our families describe when they visit. Our vision is simple: every child leaves us a confident reader, a curious thinker and a kind member of their community. We have invested heavily in our learning spaces over the past three years, including a new library and outdoor learning garden, and our staff work in collaborative professional learning teams that meet weekly with protected planning time. We offer a structured induction program, a mentor for every new staff member, generous professional learning funding, salary packaging, and access to an Employee Assistance Program. Staff wellbeing days, a staff social club and a genuine commitment to work-life balance are part of who we are.

The role
We are seeking an enthusiastic classroom teacher for a Year 2 class from Term 1 next year. You will plan with a team of four Year 2 teachers, deliver our explicit phonics and reading program, and use assessment data to differentiate learning.

Selection criteria
- Current registration with the Victorian Institute of Teaching
- Qualification in primary education
- Demonstrated knowledge of explicit literacy instruction in the early years
- Ability to build positive relationships with students, families and colleagues
- Commitment to child safety and the Child Safe Standards

Classroom Teacher Range 2. Applications close in two weeks.

title: Online Reading Teacher (K-3)
description:
BrightLeaf Learning provides live online reading instruction for K-3 students.

We are hiring remote reading teachers to deliver structured phonics lessons to small groups over video.

Requirements: certified teacher; experience with structured literacy; must reside in the United States. Applicants outside the US cannot be considered.

title: Assistant Principal - Teaching and Learning
description:
Lalor Gardens Primary School is seeking an Assistant Principal to lead teaching and learning across Foundation to Year 6.

  • Lead the school's instructional model and curriculum planning
  • Manage and coach a team of learning specialists and leading teachers
  • Oversee assessment and reporting

Applicants need at least eight years of teaching and a minimum of three years in a formal leadership role (leading teacher or above). VIT registration required.

title: Teacher - Specialist School (Autism)
description:
Merriwa Specialist School supports students aged 5-18 with autism and intellectual disability.

We are seeking a teacher for a primary-aged class of eight students, supported by two education support staff.

Essential requirements:
- VIT registration
- A postgraduate qualification in special education or inclusive education (for example a Master of Inclusive Education)
- Experience teaching students with autism in a specialist setting

Ongoing, full time.

title: Primary Teacher (Years 3-6) - Fixed Term 12 Months
description:
Glenroy West Primary School is seeking a primary teacher for a 12-month fixed-term position in our Years 3-6 area, with the class allocation to be confirmed (most likely Year 3 or Year 4).

Responsibilities
- Plan, teach and assess in line with the Victorian Curriculum 2.0
- Implement the school's literacy and numeracy instructional models
- Participate in professional learning communities and moderation
- Maintain accurate records and write semester reports

Key selection criteria
1. Current registration with the Victorian Institute of Teaching
2. Sound knowledge of primary curriculum, pedagogy and assessment
3. Ability to differentiate for a range of learners
4. Strong communication and teamwork
5. Commitment to professional growth

Fixed term (12 months), with the possibility of extension. Classroom Teacher Range 1-2.

title: Junior Software Developer
description: Laneway Digital builds web apps for Australian retailers. We are hiring a junior developer to work on our React and Node.js stack. You should have a degree in computer science or equivalent experience, a portfolio of projects on GitHub and a basic understanding of SQL. Hybrid, 3 days in our Melbourne office.

title: Classroom Teacher Aide - Education Support Level 1
description:
Reservoir East Primary School is seeking an Education Support Officer (teacher aide) to support students in our junior classrooms under the direction of the classroom teacher.

Duties include supporting small groups, preparing resources and supervising in the yard. A Certificate III or IV in Education Support is desirable. Working with Children Check required. Education Support Level 1, 0.8 FTE, school terms only.

title: Year 5/6 Teacher - STEM Focus
description:
Altona Bay Primary School is looking for a Year 5/6 teacher with a passion for STEM.

You will teach a Year 5/6 class across the curriculum and help lead our STEM program, including the robotics club and the Year 6 science expo.

Essential: VIT registration, primary teaching qualification, strong classroom management.
Desirable: experience teaching digital technologies, coding or robotics; experience with upper-primary students.

Ongoing, full time.

title: Primary Class Teacher - Year 2
description:
Hackney Fields Primary Academy is seeking a Year 2 class teacher from September.

Requirements: QTS or an overseas teaching qualification eligible for QTS recognition; experience teaching phonics in KS1.

Applicants must already hold the right to work in the UK. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

title: Primary Teacher - Literacy Focus
description:
Werribee Plains Primary School is seeking a primary teacher with strengths in early literacy to join our junior team.

  • VIT registration
  • Primary teaching qualification
  • Experience with systematic phonics and small-group reading instruction

Ongoing, full time.

title: Year 4 Classroom Teacher
description:
St Columba's Parish Primary School is a Catholic school in the Archdiocese of Melbourne, welcoming families of all backgrounds into a faith-filled learning community. Founded by the Sisters of Mercy, our school is built on the values of compassion, justice and hospitality, and these values shape how we teach, how we lead and how we care for one another. We are a single-stream-plus school of 310 students with a strong parent community, an active parish and a long tradition of excellence in literacy and the arts.

Our staff enjoy a collaborative culture with weekly team planning, a dedicated learning and teaching leader, and a whole-school commitment to evidence-based practice. Benefits include salary packaging through the Catholic sector, a staff wellbeing program, paid professional learning and support towards further study. We believe great teachers grow in supportive communities, and we invest in every member of our staff.

About the position
We are looking for a Year 4 classroom teacher, full-time and ongoing, commencing at the start of next school year.

The successful applicant will have:

  • Current VIT registration
  • Accreditation to Teach in a Catholic School (or willingness to obtain it within 12 months)
  • Sound knowledge of the Victorian Curriculum and of explicit literacy and numeracy teaching
  • Strong classroom management and communication skills
  • A commitment to the Catholic ethos of the school and to child safety

Remuneration according to the Victorian Catholic Education Multi-Enterprise Agreement.

title: Primary Teacher - Mandarin Bilingual Program
description:
Box Hill Bilingual Primary School runs a bilingual program in which students learn half of the curriculum in Mandarin.

We are seeking a primary teacher for a Year 2 bilingual class. You will teach Mathematics and Inquiry in Mandarin.

Requirements: VIT registration; native or near-native fluency in Mandarin (spoken and written) - this is essential; primary teaching qualification.

title: Deputy Principal, Junior School
description:
Ashburton Ladies College is seeking a Deputy Principal to lead our Junior School (ELC to Year 6) alongside the Head of Campus.

The successful applicant will bring significant leadership experience in a primary or junior school setting (minimum five years at middle or senior leadership level), a track record of strategic planning and staff management, and current VIT registration.

title: Reading Tutor / Learning Support (0.6 FTE)
description:
BrightPath Learning Centre helps primary-aged children who are behind in reading and spelling. We are hiring a part-time reading tutor (three afternoons and Saturday mornings) to run 1:1 and small-group sessions.

You will assess each student, follow our structured phonics program and report progress to parents each term.

We are looking for a qualified primary teacher with experience in early literacy. A Working with Children Check is required. Experience supporting students with dyslexia is a plus.

title: Store Manager - Retail
description:
Hearth & Home Living is looking for a Store Manager for our homewares store. You will lead a team of 12, drive sales targets, manage stock and rosters, and deliver great customer service. At least three years of retail management experience required. Weekend work is part of the role.

We offer a staff discount, a quarterly bonus scheme and a clear path to area management.

title: Literacy Intervention Teacher (Years 1-2)
description:
Sunshine Heights Primary School is seeking a Literacy Intervention Teacher to work with small groups of Year 1 and Year 2 students who need extra support in reading and spelling.

The role is 1.0 FTE and replaces part of a classroom load: you will run four small-group sessions each day, track progress fortnightly and meet with classroom teachers to plan next steps.

You will need:
• Current VIT registration
• Demonstrated experience delivering systematic synthetic phonics
• Experience using assessment data (phonics checks, running records or similar) to group students and measure progress
• Strong relationships with students and colleagues

Desirable: experience leading literacy professional learning for colleagues.

This is an ongoing position commencing Term 1.

title: Virtual Elementary Teacher - Grade 2
description:
Maple Virtual Academy is a fully online elementary school.

We are hiring a Grade 2 teacher to teach live online classes. You must reside in Ontario, Canada and hold certification with the Ontario College of Teachers. This role is remote but restricted to Ontario residents.

You will teach a class of up to 20 students through our online platform, deliver structured literacy and numeracy lessons, and hold regular conferences with families.

title: Pre-service Primary School Teacher - Paid Internship
description:
Teach Forward Victoria offers paid internships for final-year Bachelor or Master of Teaching students. Interns work two days a week in a partner primary school under the supervision of a mentor teacher while completing their degree.

Eligibility: you must be currently enrolled in the final year of an initial teacher education program. Applicants who already hold VIT registration are not eligible.

title: Homeroom Educator, Years 3-4
description:
Homeroom Educator, Years 3-4 - full-time, ongoing

Riversdale College is a co-educational independent school in Hawthorn. Our Years 3-4 homeroom educators teach the core program (English, Mathematics and Inquiry) to their own class and work closely with specialist teachers.

  • Teach a homeroom class of up to 24 students
  • Deliver structured literacy lessons and small-group reading support
  • Use assessment data to plan and report on student learning
  • Build strong partnerships with families

Requirements: current VIT registration, a primary teaching qualification and at least two years of classroom experience. Experience with explicit phonics and reading fluency instruction is highly regarded.

Riversdale College is committed to child safety.

title: Primary Teacher - Year 3
description:
Albury Riverside Public School is a NSW public school of 420 students on the banks of the Murray River. We are seeking a primary teacher for a Year 3 class from the start of next year.

Requirements
- Accreditation with NESA (NSW Education Standards Authority) before your start date. Teachers registered in another state, including Victoria, can apply for accreditation through mutual recognition; we will support you through the process.
- A Working with Children Check for NSW (the NSW check is separate from the Victorian WWCC).
- Primary teaching qualification and classroom experience.

Relocation support available for interstate applicants. Full time, permanent.

title: Primary Music Specialist
description:
Camberwell Hill Primary School is seeking a music specialist to teach classroom music from Foundation to Year 6 and lead the school band and choir.

Essential: VIT registration; a tertiary qualification in music or music education; proficiency on piano or guitar; experience running school ensembles.

title: Year 4 Classroom Teacher
description:
St Anne's Catholic Primary School in Kensington is seeking a Year 4 classroom teacher for an ongoing, full-time role from the start of next year.

You will plan with one other Year 4 teacher and our learning and teaching leader.

Required: VIT registration and Accreditation to Teach in a Catholic School (or willingness to obtain it).
Highly regarded: experience with explicit literacy instruction.

title: Primary Teacher - Year 1
description:
Al Waha British School is seeking a Year 1 teacher to join us in Dubai.

Package: tax-free salary, furnished accommodation, medical insurance and an annual flight allowance.

Requirements: qualified primary teacher, two or more years of experience, strong phonics knowledge. The position is on-site at our Dubai campus.

title: Customer Success Associate (EdTech SaaS)
description:
ClassNest makes school management software used by 600 schools. As a Customer Success Associate you will onboard new school customers, run product training webinars, handle support escalations and work towards renewal targets.

We need 1-2 years in customer success or account management at a SaaS company, and you must be comfortable with CRM tools. A background in schools is helpful but not required.

title: Primary Classroom Teacher - Foundation
company: Our Lady of the Rosary Primary School
description:
Our Lady of the Rosary is a Catholic primary school of 260 students in Coburg. We are seeking a passionate primary classroom teacher to lead a Foundation class next year.

Our Foundation program focuses on oral language, phonemic awareness and explicit phonics, alongside play-based learning in the afternoons. You will work in a team of two Foundation teachers with a learning support officer.

Applicants must have:
- current VIT registration
- Accreditation to Teach in a Catholic School, or be willing to obtain it
- experience teaching in the early years of primary school
- a commitment to child safety and the mission of Catholic education

Full time, ongoing. Salary according to the relevant enterprise agreement.

title: Head of Junior School
description:
Mount Waverley Grammar invites applications for the position of Head of Junior School, a member of the school executive responsible for 520 students and 45 staff.

You will have at least ten years of teaching experience, including significant time in senior leadership, a postgraduate qualification in education or leadership, and VIT registration.

title: Primary Teacher - Montessori 6-9 Class
description:
Elm Street Montessori School is seeking a teacher for our 6-9 (lower primary) class.

Our classrooms follow the Montessori approach, with mixed-age groups, long uninterrupted work periods and hands-on materials. Teachers guide individual and small-group lessons rather than whole-class instruction.

Requirements: VIT registration and a primary teaching qualification. A Montessori 6-12 diploma is preferred; if you do not hold one, we will fund your training over two years.

Part time (0.8) or full time considered.

title: Online English Teacher - Primary Learners
description:
LinguaKids teaches English to children aged 6-11 in small live online classes.

Requirements: qualified primary teacher; native-level English; must be resident in the EU and able to invoice as a freelancer within the EU. We cannot engage teachers living outside Europe.

Classes run in the European afternoon and early evening, with four to six children per group. Lesson plans and materials are provided.

title: Literacy Content Writer - Primary Teacher Resources
description:
Inkwell Education Press publishes print and digital literacy resources for primary teachers.

We are seeking a content writer to write and edit lesson plans, worksheets and teacher notes. You will work to tight publishing deadlines with our editorial team.

Requirements: proven writing and editing experience in publishing or content production; strong grammar; experience with InDesign is a plus. A teaching background is useful but not essential.

title: Junior School Classroom Teacher (Year 3)
description:
Kingsbury Grammar is an independent, co-educational Anglican school educating students from early learning to Year 12 across two campuses in Melbourne's inner east. For over a century we have combined academic rigour with a deep commitment to wellbeing, service and the arts, and we are known for small classes, outstanding co-curricular programs and a genuinely caring staff culture. Our Junior School campus sits on leafy grounds with purpose-built learning studios, a dedicated library, a performing arts centre and an aquatic centre shared with the senior campus.

Joining Kingsbury means joining a professional community that values growth. All staff receive an individual professional learning budget, a mentoring partnership in their first year, and access to our in-house teaching and learning program. Benefits include generous above-award salaries, tuition fee remission for children of staff, onsite parking, a staff gym, free flu vaccinations and a comprehensive wellbeing program. We support flexible arrangements where the needs of the school allow.

About the role
We are seeking a Year 3 classroom teacher for a full-time, ongoing position. You will work in a team of three Year 3 teachers, deliver an explicit, structured literacy program and contribute to the wider life of the Junior School.

To be successful you will need:
- Full or provisional registration with the Victorian Institute of Teaching
- A tertiary qualification in primary teaching
- Demonstrated expertise in early literacy, including systematic phonics
- Excellent communication with parents and colleagues
- A commitment to child safety

Kingsbury Grammar is a child safe organisation. All applicants must comply with the school's child safe policies.

title: Teacher of the Deaf - Primary (Visiting Teacher)
description:
We are seeking a visiting Teacher of the Deaf to support deaf and hard of hearing students in mainstream primary schools across Melbourne's north.

Essential:

  • VIT registration
  • A qualification in deaf education
  • Fluency in Auslan (Certificate IV or higher)
  • Current driver's licence

title: EAL Teacher - Primary
description:
Dallas Heights Primary School has a vibrant community where more than 80% of students speak a language other than English at home.

We are seeking an EAL teacher to support students in Foundation to Year 6 through small-group and in-class support, and to help classroom teachers plan for English language learners.

Essential: VIT registration; primary teaching qualification; strong knowledge of literacy teaching.

Desirable: TESOL or EAL qualification; experience using the Victorian EAL curriculum.

title: Primary Classroom Teacher
description:
Melton Grove Primary School is hiring a primary classroom teacher for a Foundation to Year 2 class. You will need VIT registration, a primary teaching qualification and a commitment to child safety. Ongoing, full time.

Our junior team plans together weekly, and every new staff member is paired with a mentor for their first year. Experience with structured literacy is highly regarded.

title: Primary School Teacher - Junior Years
description:
Brunswick North Primary School invites applications for a primary school teacher in our junior years (Foundation to Year 2) from Term 1.

Our school community values inquiry, wellbeing and high expectations for every learner. We have a whole-school approach to structured literacy and invest in coaching for all teaching staff.

Role
- Teach a junior class (year level to be confirmed)
- Contribute to the junior team's planning and assessment schedule
- Communicate regularly with families through Seesaw and conferences

Requirements
- Registered with the Victorian Institute of Teaching
- Bachelor or Master of Teaching (Primary) or equivalent
- Knowledge of explicit and systematic literacy teaching
- Commitment to child safety

Ongoing, full time. Classroom Teacher Range 1 or 2 depending on experience.

title: Elementary Teacher - Grade 3
description:
Don Valley Elementary is hiring a Grade 3 teacher.

Requirements: Ontario College of Teachers certification (or eligibility); experience with structured literacy.

Candidates must be legally entitled to work in Canada. We do not provide work visa sponsorship.

You will teach a Grade 3 class of 25 students, work with our literacy coach and contribute to school-wide reading assessment.

title: Online English Tutor (Primary Years) - Remote
description:
Tutorly Australia connects families with qualified teachers for live online lessons. We are hiring tutors to teach English and reading to primary-aged students over video, after school hours and on weekends.

Requirements: Australian resident; qualified teacher (registration in any Australian state); a Working with Children Check; reliable internet and a quiet space to teach from.

Flexible hours, paid fortnightly.

title: Primary Teacher - Year 2
description:
Kowloon Harbour International School is seeking a Year 2 teacher for our primary school in Hong Kong.

Requirements: qualified primary teacher with at least two years of experience, strong literacy and phonics knowledge. The role is on-site at our Kowloon campus; relocation package provided.

You will teach a class of 24 students, plan with a team of three and contribute to the school's reading program and parent workshops.

title: Primary Teacher - Year 2 (Parental Leave Cover 2027)
description:
Thornbury Park Primary School is seeking a Year 2 primary teacher to cover parental leave for the 2027 school year.

You will teach a class of 23 students, work with a highly collaborative Year 2 team and deliver our structured literacy program, which includes daily phonics, decodable text reading and explicit writing lessons.

Essential:

  • VIT registration
  • Primary teaching qualification
  • Experience in the early years of primary school

Desirable: experience with small-group reading intervention.

Fixed term, full time, 12 months.
